title: Three-floor elevator controller
summary: Sequencing an elevator with call memory and proximity-based priorities.
overview: An industrial-automation project modelling control of a three-floor elevator.
constraints: The controller must account for calls, direction, position, overload and emergency-stop behaviour.
contribution: Academic control and PLC work, as documented in my previous technical portfolio.
approach: The study describes sequential function charts, state memory and a proximity rule for serving multiple pending calls.
results: The previous portfolio documents implementation and simulation of the control logic.
limits: Simulation of scheduling logic is distinct from certification or validation of a physical elevator.
